# volcano_projects (Data Source)

List Volcano projects on the account, optionally filtered by search term.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_projects" "all" {}

data "volcano_projects" "filtered" {
  search = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Optional free-text filter on project name.
